name: task_evidence_read
description: Read evidence for one task. The default source=progress refreshes and returns its bounded phase/checkpoint snapshot for diagnosis. source=delivered reads the full persisted status and payload without collecting, refreshing progress, or integrating; available after collection and context compression. Use task_audit for all recorded IDs. Reading never acknowledges integration.

task_id.description: Exact task_id returned by task_spawn or listed by task_audit. Delivered lookup preserves the ID verbatim.

source.description: progress preserves the existing live snapshot behavior; delivered performs a read-only lookup of a previously delivered result.

fields.description: Optional non-empty list of top-level evidence field names. Unavailable names return an error listing available fields. Omit for no field selection; omitting both fields and max_chars preserves the original output. Available when ai.agent_team.optimizations_enabled is true.

max_chars.description: Optional payload limit counted in Unicode scalar values, not bytes; response metadata is outside this limit. Truncation reports shown_chars, total_chars, truncated, and a full-read recovery hint. 0 returns an empty payload. Omit for no character limit; omitting both fields and max_chars preserves the original output. Available when ai.agent_team.optimizations_enabled is true.
